The '''United Kingdom Census 1871''' was a [[census]] of the [[United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland]] carried out on Sunday 2 April 1871.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/help-with-your-research/research-guides/census-records/#6-when-were-the-censuses-taken|title=Census records|access-date=7 March 2018|publisher=The National Archives}}</ref> It added the categories of "lunatic" to those recorded as infirm.<ref>[http://webarchive.nationalarchives.gov.uk/20160128181439/http://www.ons.gov.uk/ons/guide-method/census/2011/census-history/200-years-of-the-census/1801-1901/index.html 1801-1901.] Office for National Statistics. Archived by The National Archives 28 January 2016. Retrieved 13 July 2017.</ref>

The total population of England, Wales and Scotland was recorded as 26,072,036.<ref>{{cite web |title=1871 England, Wales & Scotland Census |url=https://search.findmypast.co.uk/search-world-records/1871-england-wales-and-scotland-census |publisher=FindMyPast |access-date=15 December 2021}}</ref>
